Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the mention of the patients, add a physical detail to show how ill they are: “他们脸色很差，肚子疼得直冒汗。”
2. When the character suspects the plants are dangerous, add his inner question: “这些植物是不是有毒？”
3. When the flower appears, describe its shape or colour: “花又大又漂亮，像星星一样。”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete sign of the patients’ illness and fits the situation.
The learner already says that Shennong thinks the plants may be poisonous.
This adds a simple visual detail to the flower without changing the scene.
